releaseNotes: MultiClone Pro v4.3.3 - Root cause fixes for clone not opening. (1) ProxyActivity: fixed unconditional finish() order - now launches target first, then finishes. (2) BPackageUserState: default installed=true for missing user state (was permanent null). (3) ActivityStack.synchronizeTasks: preserve live tasks when recents unavailable (was wiping all). (4) Removed Google Play Service / Clone-detection code per user order. (5) Full English UI (removed Hindi/Chinese strings). Keeps v4.3.2 fixes.
